new_findings.summary: The WSL interop mitigation was incomplete: closing PE-binary execution did not close the interop IPC endpoints. /run/WSL/*_interop, the session bus and the system bus accepted connect() from inside the sandbox, because pathname AF_UNIX sockets cross network namespaces and those paths sat on the read-only bind of /.
new_findings.note: The re-auditor stopped at reachability and sent no protocol message, so this was plausible rather than demonstrated. It falsified no published sentence, since all three carried 'does not demonstrate that no other path exists'.
new_findings.how: The orchestrator reproduced the reachability (CONNECT_OK on three interop sockets and both buses), then added --tmpfs /run. Re-verified: /run empty, interop_sockets_visible 0, git still works, reads work, writes still EROFS. The verifier now asserts wsl_interop_sockets_unreachable and an eleventh regression test covers it.

new_findings.summary: agent-capabilities.json still said the auditor was 'not described here as having done anything' while the same commit described at length what the auditor did: the very defect class F-03 created the record to fix.
new_findings.how: Both auditor passes are now recorded under observed_readers, the intended-but-not-dispatched block is removed, and a revision_history records all three versions and why each changed.

new_findings.summary: evidence-manifest.json self-declared the previously audited commit with tree_clean false and had no self-reference field, so its header would mislead a reader asking which commit it describes. Its content was correct: 30/30 hashes verified.
new_findings.how: The generator now emits a self_reference_limit and a published_in_commit field explaining that a manifest cannot name a commit that does not yet exist.

new_findings.summary: A self-reference note gave a verification recipe that is false as written ('the final commit touches only those three paths plus this JSON'; it touches twelve).
new_findings.how: Rewritten to state the substantive claim, that nothing but JSON records changed after the run, and to say it is verifiable by timestamp rather than by file count.

new_findings.summary: workflow-events.jsonl contained zero occurrences of 'auditor': neither audit pass, nor correction cycles 2 and 3, were in the ledger that SC-GOV-007 describes as holding the dispatch and report of every role.
new_findings.how: Six events added: dispatch and report of both auditor passes and correction cycles 2 and 3. The ledger now holds 23 events.
